content_sections.heading: NAM Idukki Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: National AYUSH Mission, Idukki District (Office of the District Programme Manager)
Indian Systems of Medicine department and Homoeopathy department, through National AYUSH Mission
17 posts, including Yoga Instructor (AHWC), Therapist (Female), Therapist (Male), GNM Nurse, Senior Lab Technician and other posts
Rs. 10,500 to Rs. 25,000 monthly pay, varies by post

content_sections.heading: About NAM Idukki
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, Idukki District, which works from its camp office in the District Ayurveda Hospital Building, Thodupuzha, Idukki, PIN-685585. The office seal names the District AYUSH Health Society, Idukki. Through the National AYUSH Mission, the office fills posts in the Indian Systems of Medicine department and the Homoeopathy department in Idukki district.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 17 posts. For every post, the vacancy column shows "Anticipatory"; no number of posts is printed. The monthly pay for each post is as printed below.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification, printed in the notice's table. Short qualifications are in the table below; the longer ones follow it. The candidate must have passed one of the following: BNYS/BAMS degree from a Government-recognised university, or MSc (Yoga) / MPhil (Yoga) PG Diploma in Yoga of not less than one year from a Government-recognised university A recognised certificate course of one-year duration in Yoga from a recognised university A recognised certificate of one-year duration in Yoga from a Government department A Yoga Teacher Training Course (D.Y.T. course) of not less than one year from the State Resource Centre The notice gives the age limit post by post and does not print an "as on" date for counting age. For Multi Purpose Health Worker (AHWC) and Physiotherapist, the age limit is not specified in the notice. Age relaxation is also not mentioned in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay in the vacancy table is the monthly pay (pratimasa vethanam) printed for each post, ranging from Rs. 10,500 for Attender to Rs. 25,000 for Senior Lab Technician. The appointment is a temporary appointment on contract basis. The notice does not mention the length of the contract or any allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Idukki Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility conditions listed for their post must submit the application online through the website https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in . Fill in all details clearly in the online application; incomplete applications will be rejected without any consideration. Make sure every detail entered matches the original documents, as these are produced at the interview. Submit the online application on or before 1 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: According to the notice, if there are more than 20 candidates, the selection process may include a written test and an interview as needed. If the details given in the application do not match the original documents produced at the interview, the candidate's application will be rejected. The notice does not give a date for the written test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NAM Idukki Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for NAM Idukki Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in; incomplete applications will be rejected without consideration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GNM Nurse in NAM Idukki?
faq.answer: GNM Nurse requires BSc nursing approved by a recognized University or GNM Nursing approved by a recognized Nursing School, with Kerala Nursing & midwife council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NAM Idukki posts?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 50 years for Yoga Instructor (AHWC) and should not exceed 40 years for 14 other posts; no age limit is printed for Multi Purpose Health Worker (AHWC) and Physiotherapist.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary in NAM Idukki Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The monthly pay ranges from Rs. 10,500 (Attender) to Rs. 25,000 (Senior Lab Technician); GNM Nurse gets Rs. 17,850 and Physiotherapist Rs. 21,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NAM Idukki Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: If there are more than 20 candidates, a written test and an interview may be included as needed, and original documents are checked at the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NAM Idukki job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the notice invites applications for temporary appointment on contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Which course is accepted for Therapist posts in NAM Idukki?
faq.answer: An Ayurveda Therapist course of not less than one year conducted by the Government of Kerala (DAME) is required; those who completed the one-year Panchakarma Ayurveda Therapy course from NARIP Cheruthuruthy will also be considered.

faq.question: Q9. Is BCCPN/CCPN required for Multi Purpose Worker (Karunya)?
faq.answer: No, BCCPN/CCPN gives preference for Multi Purpose Worker (Karunya); it is listed as essential for Palliative Nurse.
